name: vertex_dedup_ai_matching_degraded
description: Production Cloud Run AI matching DEGRADED log entries. Counts log entries, not comparisons; no patient labels.
filter:
resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
resource.labels.service_name="tabula-medica-web"
resource.labels.location="us-central1"
(severity>=ERROR OR jsonPayload.level="error" OR jsonPayload.level="critical")
(jsonPayload.message:"[VertexDedup] AI matching DEGRADED" OR textPayload:"[VertexDedup] AI matching DEGRADED")
